checkpointPolicy.reason: Record evidence before editing and before finish to prevent documentation drift.

acceptance: docs/CAPABILITIES.md provides a reader-facing capability matrix grouped by product/research, evidence/data, system/runtime, and engineering-quality capabilities.
Every listed capability has a status label, a concise boundary statement, at least one detailed documentation link, and an evidence link to current code, tests, or an explicit non-goal.
The overview distinguishes source-backed, interface-or-fixture-bounded, externally-unverified, and non-goal states without claiming a production receipt that does not exist.
README.md and docs/README.md expose the capability overview from their reader entry paths, while existing detailed document paths remain stable.
scripts/check_docs_metadata.py includes the new reader document so headings, internal links, forbidden process markers, and runtime alignment are checked.

After implementation, check-docs-metadata, required AI Cockpit checks, strict Finish, archive, PR hosted checks, merge, and ai-close-work-item all return success, with clean main and no codex branch or worktree residue.
guidelines: Use evidence-bound status labels and distinguish implemented, boundary-only, external-validation-limited, and non-goal capabilities.
Keep the capability overview reader-oriented; do not include Work Item progress, branch, PR, or implementation chronology.
Use links to existing detailed documents instead of duplicating long specifications.
Do not invent product capabilities or claim real provider or production verification without an authorized receipt.
Use Chinese as the primary prose language while retaining stable English code and domain terms.

intent.problem: The repository has many detailed documents and implemented modules, but no single evidence-bound capability map. A reader must open several files before understanding what exists, what is bounded by fixtures or external verification, and what is explicitly not a product goal.
constraints: Keep the overview static, repository-local, and link-driven.
Preserve existing detailed document paths and internal engineering records.
Do not change runtime behavior or infer product policy from implementation names.
State external provider and production verification limits explicitly.
Complete the full AI Cockpit lifecycle without requiring another intermediate confirmation.
intent.rationale: A compact capability matrix at the reader entry point reduces discovery cost while links preserve the authoritative detail in existing documents. Evidence-bound status labels prevent a navigation artifact from becoming an unsupported product promise.
